race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
race.verdict: Plenty with chances but the Gosdens' lightly-raced LIGHTING THUNDER made a promising return from an absence when fourth on his recent handicap debut at Newmarket and gets the vote with more improvement very much on the cards from this son of Night Of Thunder. Lost Signal also looks to have better days ahead of him and is next on the list, while Canvas , Nepal and Rhoscolyn are all in the mix too. LIGHTING THUNDER LOST SIGNAL (IRE) CANVAS
race.bettingForecast: Lighting Thunder (5/1), Canvas (6/1), Lost Signal (7/1), Nepal (8/1), Mcmurray (8/1), God Of War (8/1), Saytarr (10/1), Fantastic Fox (10/1), Rhoscolyn (12/1), Samra Green (12/1), Supido (14/1), Previous (16/1), Old Cock (25/1)
